rows.lemma: oṃ namo bhagavati vikaṭe vīrapālike prasīdaprasīda
rows.grounds: mantra block given as [oṃ namo bhagavati vikaṭe vīrapālike prasīdaprasīda ||]; preserved byte-exact per transmission brief
bhagavati = to-goddess; vocative of address to the goddess
vikaṭe = to-vikaṭā; vocative epithet of the goddess
vīrapālike = to-hero-protector; vocative epithet/compound name of the goddess
